answer: Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The ivory decay curve is applied at each close, summit records the drop, and plume recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. That is 806 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
